name: Inner Peace (Maenad)
body:
–

Benefit: You have studied philosophy and theology as a way to handle the mental turmoil of your race. Knowledge (Religion) and Knowledge (Psionics) are both class skills for you. If either or both are already class skills, you gain a +1 trait bonus to them.

Special: Only Maenads may select this racial trait.
